text:
🇲🇽💊 <u>MEDICINE MEGA-PURCHASE: CONTRACTS TO MEXICAN SUPPLIERS MORE THAN DOUBLE</u>

The Health Ministry awarded 3.2 billion units of medicines for 2027-2028 through a public tender worth nearly 84 billion pesos, reports El Economista — 626 codes of generics, oncology drugs and anti-infectives, 85% of the first round, split among 102 companies.

The value of contracts going to Mexican suppliers jumped 127%, from 27 billion to 62 billion pesos, without raising purchase costs.

🇲🇽👩 <u>MEXICALI: 27,000 WOMEN THROUGH THE WELFARE CENTER IN TWO YEARS</u>

Baja California's Centro Integrador del Bienestar in Mexicali marked its second anniversary with more than 27,000 women served — primary and secondary school accreditation, high school enrollment, job training and income-generating workshops, all under one roof. Governor Marina del Pilar Ávila announced the model will be replicated in San Quintín and Tijuana.

"Thank you for this great wellness project, because it has opened doors for many personal projects," said beneficiary Ramona de los Ángeles.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>"SHIELD OF THE AMERICAS" TARGETS MEXICAN CARTELS AND REVIVES THE RIO TREATY — MEXICO DIDN'T SIGN</u>

At its second meeting, held on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Washington's "Shield of the Americas" agreed to go after 24 "narcoterrorist" organizations — including the CJNG and the Sinaloa, Gulf and Northeast cartels and La Nueva Familia Michoacana — with asset freezes, visa bans and criminal liability for "material support."

The signatories also asked the OAS to convene consultations under the Rio Treaty (TIAR) for "collective action." The 15 signers: the US, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guyana, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay, Peru and Trinidad and Tobago. Mexico is not among them.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>CALDERÓN'S "MEXICO 2030": MEXICAN-AMERICANS IN POWER, SOVEREIGNTY PHASED OUT</u>

A document obtained by Contralínea shows that months after the 2006 election, Felipe Calderón, PRIAN politicians and right-wing intellectuals drafted "México 2030. Proyecto de Gran Visión." Its Axis 5 anticipated that by 2030 "some Mexican-Americans" would hold "relevant public office" in finance, trade and public policy as part of the "process of integration with North America" — with "shared institutions" and Mexico's armed forces available for "hemispheric security."

The plan explicitly ruled out a BRIC-style development path. This week the Chamber of Deputies approved Sheinbaum's reform barring dual nationals from the presidency and governorships.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>US AMBASSADOR PRAISES MARU CAMPOS WHILE THE FGR INVESTIGATES THE CIA OPERATION IN CHIHUAHUA</u>

US Ambassador Ronald Johnson publicly praised Chihuahua's PAN governor María Eugenia Campos for her "commitment to security" — five months after the FGR opened an investigation into the operation in which two CIA agents died on Chihuahuan soil.

Johnson also saluted her state security chief Gilberto Loya, saying their work "is helping make communities on both sides of our border safer." A foreign ambassador vouching for a governor whose dealings with US agents are under federal investigation.
